# kkp_project_member (Resource)

Gives a user (by e-mail) a role in a project. Managing owners needs an owner token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kkp_project_member" "jane" {
  email = "jane@example.com"
  group = "viewers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The user's e-mail address, as their identity provider reports it.
- `group` (String) Role: `owners`, `editors`, `viewers` or `projectmanagers`.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) KKP user ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import kkp_project_member.jane <project_id>/<user_id>
```
